results.rule: An account cannot spend more than it has
Only the key of an account can move its coins
The coin has no function that creates coins
The founder vault observes the 12-month lock and the monthly calendar
The founder vault requires the usage milestone
The founder vault waits out the 30-day notice
A vetoed slice stays unpaid
Founder-linked accounts have no vote on a founder release
Votes weigh by the balance on the notice day
Founder-linked checks stay out of the milestone count
The bond goes to the customer when the work was not done
A false finding costs the checker stake
A challenge is accepted only inside the window
A party to a claim cannot check it
A checker with unfinished checks cannot withdraw its stake
Only the key of the operator posts its claim
A claim carries a fee of at least the minimum
A claim that cannot pay its fee moves no dollars
The fee leaves the poster when the claim is posted
One fifth of every fee goes to the community pool
An overturned finding pays the fee to the challenger
An overturned finding cannot be challenged again
A claim waits 30 days for a checker before it can be withdrawn
Only the operator can withdraw its claim
The fee returns to the poster when a claim is withdrawn
A finding is judged against the system as it stood on the day of the finding
A sworn statement carries a bond of at least the minimum
A sworn statement covers 30 to 365 days
An issuer without the coins for the bond and the fee cannot post
The bond and the fee leave the issuer when the statement is posted
Only the key of the issuer posts its sworn statement
A statement goes in force only when its first check reads true
A report is accepted only during the term
A reporter puts up the report bond
A statement that still reads true stays in force
One fifth of a forfeited bond pays the reporter and the rest goes to the community pool
The bond returns only after the term
The bond returns when an untaken statement is withdrawn
Reports and closings apply to sworn statements only
Each receipt is linked to the one before it
The report card flags a coin whose accounts can be frozen
The report card reports unread facts as unread
